stories.title: Former Chicago Tribune sportswriter Fred Mitchell dies at 78
stories.summary: Former Chicago Tribune sportswriter Fred Mitchell, 78, died Tuesday after a battle with leukemia, his family announced. Mitchell spent more than four decades at the Chicago Tribune, He started at the Tribune in 1974, becoming the first African American sportswriter at the Tribune. At the Tribune, Mitchell served as a beat writer for the Chicago Bulls, Cubs and Bears before becoming a columnist. After retiring from the Tribune, he went on to serve as an adjunct professor at Northwestern University and DePaul University.
